title: Affine formal modules: Complete
statement: Let A, I, B, X, J and Q be as in the statement dependencies. Let L be any functor from coherent formal J-modules to finite B-modules, with a family p(F) of cones from restricted L(F) to Gamma(F_n). Assume each cone is limiting, the projections commute with maps L(f), and projection of r x equals a times projection of x whenever r has residue a modulo I^(n+1). Then Q followed by L is naturally isomorphic to the identity on finite B-modules. No surjectivity or kernel hypothesis is imposed. The conclusion is only the finite-module half of an equivalence.

source.place: Lemma 087W, the implicit converse N=lim N/I^n N; original node step 6; Algebra 00MA (3), 0316, 05GG

proof.text: Use the explicit canonical quotient cone for each N, with its limiting and residue-scalar properties. Compare the assumed limit cone p(Q(N)) to this cone by IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso to obtain an A-linear isomorphism L(Q(N)) -> N commuting with projections.

For each completed scalar r and coordinate n, choose a representative a of its residue in A/I^(n+1). Apply the two scalar identities and the projection compatibility. The canonical cone projections jointly separate elements (Concrete.isLimit_ext), so the comparison is B-linear. Its underlying additive equivalence is therefore a B-linear equivalence.

Prove naturality of the explicit quotient projections using naturality of the tilde/global-sections unit and the cokernel defining formalModuleQuotientMap. For any map f compare the desired naturality equation after every canonical projection; hnatural and comparison compatibility give equality. Joint separation proves naturality. Lift the component linear equivalences to the full subcategory and apply NatIso.ofComponents.

theorem coherentFormalModules_affine_complete (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (L : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J ⥤
    ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A) ↦ Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N))
    (p : ∀ F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J,
      (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj
          (L.obj F).obj) ⟶ F.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A))
    (hlimit : (∀ F, Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ (p F)))))
    (hnatural : (∀ (F G : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (f : F ⟶ G)
      (n : ℕ),
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).map
        (L.map f).hom ≫ (p G).app (op n) =
      (p F).app (op n) ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map (f.hom.app (op n))))
    (hscalar : (∀ (F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (n : ℕ)
      (r : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A) (x : (L.obj F).obj),
      AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1) r = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)) a →
      (p F).app (op n) (r • x) = a • (p F).app (op n) x)) :
    Nonempty ((coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientFunctor A I J hJ) ⋙ L ≅ 𝟭 _)
